limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

claims.text: A 62-year-old female with melanoma received nivolumab and ipilimumab and developed ICI-associated panuveitis alongside systemic irAE of adrenal failure. Ocular symptoms began 13 days after ICI administration, with bilateral ocular involvement. Tumor response to ICI was recorded as partial response.

Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

claims.text: A 50-year-old female with uterine cancer received pembrolizumab and developed ICI-associated posterior uveitis alongside systemic irAE of thyroiditis and dermatitis. Ocular symptoms began 73 days after ICI administration, with bilateral ocular involvement. Tumor response to ICI was recorded as not evaluable.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

claims.text: A 51-year-old male with melanoma received pembrolizumab and developed ICI-associated panuveitis. Ocular symptoms began 952 days after ICI administration, with bilateral ocular involvement. Tumor response to ICI was recorded as complete response.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

claims.text: A 54-year-old female with melanoma received nivolumab and developed ICI-associated anterior uveitis alongside systemic irAE of hepatopathy. Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

claims.text: A 80-year-old female with gastric cancer received nivolumab and developed ICI-associated panuveitis. Ocular symptoms began 332 days after ICI administration, with bilateral ocular involvement. Tumor response to ICI was recorded as stable disease.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

claims.text: Ocular treatment was steroid pulse therapy. ICI therapy was discontinued permanently because of an ocular irAE. Final best corrected visual acuity was OD 0.5 on the decimal scale; ocular complication recorded: Optic atrophy. The optic neuritis developed after three cycles of nivolumab; initial visual acuity was described as finger counting, and after three courses of steroid pulse therapy it improved to 20/40. Visual acuity of 20/40 or worse at final observation was attributed to optic neuritis.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

Ocular symptoms began 12 days after ICI administration, with bilateral ocular involvement. Tumor response to ICI was recorded as progressive disease.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

claims.text: A 63-year-old female with melanoma received nivolumab and ipilimumab and developed ICI-associated panuveitis alongside systemic irAE of myocarditis, hepatopathy and dermatitis. Ocular symptoms began 24 days after ICI administration, with bilateral ocular involvement. Tumor response to ICI was recorded as stable disease.

limitations: Retrospective single-center case series; patient numbers follow first mention in the source (patient 15 is named in the results text before Table 1), so patient ids p1..p16 do not match the table row numbers.
Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.

claims.text: A 72-year-old female with melanoma received nivolumab and ipilimumab and developed ICI-associated panuveitis alongside systemic irAE of hepatopathy and thyroiditis. Ocular symptoms began 12 days after ICI administration, with bilateral ocular involvement. Tumor response to ICI was recorded as stable disease.

Blank or dash cells (systemic irAE, granulomatous inflammation, VKH disease-like uveitis, ocular complications) are not recorded as absence because the table has no legend stating their meaning.

HLA genotyping in two VKH disease-like uveitis patients, the one patient who improved spontaneously with ICI discontinuation alone, the six topical-only patients and the systemic steroid indications are described without naming patients and are not assigned to individuals.

Table 2 and the discussion are cohort-level statistics and literature comparisons and are not copied to individuals; Japanese ethnicity is recorded from the cohort sentence that explicitly covers all 16 patients.
Ages are in years per the cohort description; Table 1 gives no unit for the Age/sex column.
Case 16 ocular complication is a source conflict between suspected optic neuropathy (table) and suspected optic neuritis (text).
The article has no figures and no supplements.
